text_block_list.text:
Magnificently conquering the Satsuki Sho, 
she claimed the first jewel of the Triple 
Crown. Mejiro Bright rejoiced, knowing she 
had avenged Mejiro Ryan's past regret.

Mejiro Ryan is touched by her feelings, 
but tells her that she wants her to 'run 
for herself.'

The reason she hadn't been able to run 
well... It was because she had been 
carrying far too much of the Mejiro 
family's weight on her shoulders.

"I want Bright to run for Bright's sake"— 
Mejiro Bright responded to those feelings 
with a smile, and prepared for the 
upcoming "Japanese Derby."
